headline: BNP MP Ferdousi Ahmed Misty resigns after attack on health center
summary: The reserved seat for women (Seat-23) has been declared vacant following her resignation, with a by-poll expected within 90 days.
details: BNP MP Ferdousi Ahmed Misty has resigned from her parliamentary seat, which has been officially declared vacant. The move comes following a directive from the Prime Minister's Office and Tarique Rahman.
caption:

headline_marked: 9 goals conceded: [[Bangladesh crushed 9-2 by Indonesia]] in final match
headline: 9 goals conceded: Bangladesh crushed 9-2 by Indonesia in final match
summary: The Red-Green army suffered a heavy defeat at the Bung Karno Stadium, marking a disappointing end to their FIFA ASEAN Cup campaign.
details: Bangladesh suffered a devastating 9-2 loss against host Indonesia in their final match of the FIFA ASEAN Cup at the Bung Karno Stadium in Jakarta.
Indonesia's Mitchell Baker, a USL League Two player, dominated the match, scoring five goals, including a hat-trick in the first half.
Bangladesh managed to score two goals through Shahriyar Emon and Farhan Ali, but they were unable to to stop the Indonesian onslaught.
The first half ended with Indonesia leading 6-1, after goals from Mitchell Baker, Rizki Ridho, and Justin Hubner.
Tensions flared late in the game as players from both sides engaged in scuffles, leading to the fourth official to add seven minutes of stoppage time.
This marks the third time in history that the Bangladesh national football team has conceded nine goals in a single match, following losses to South Korea in 1979 and Iran in 1982.
Coach Tamas Duly has stated that improvement does not happen overnight, following the heavy defeat.
caption:
A crushing 9-2 defeat. Bangladesh exits the FIFA ASEAN Cup in total collapse.

Bangladesh suffered a devastating 9-2 loss against host Indonesia in their final match of the FIFA ASEAN Cup at the Bung Karno Stadium in Jakarta.

Indonesia's Mitchell Baker, a USL League Two player, dominated the match, scoring five goals, including a hat-trick in the first half.

Bangladesh managed to score two goals through Shahriyar Emon and Farhan Ali, but they were unable to to stop the Indonesian onslaught.

The first half ended with Indonesia leading 6-1, after goals from Mitchell Baker, Rizki Ridho, and Justin Hubner.

Tensions flared late in the game as players from both sides engaged in scuffles, leading to the fourth official to add seven minutes of stoppage time.

This marks the third time in history that the Bangladesh national football team has conceded nine goals in a single match, following losses to South Korea in 1979 and Iran in 1982.

Coach Tamas Duly has stated that improvement does not happen overnight, following the heavy defeat.

#Bangladesh #Indonesia #FIFAASEANCup #Football #AsiaCup

Source: Jamuna TV, Prothom Alo
